title: Power Rankings: Cavs keep No. 1 spot
heading: 2009-10 Power Rankings: Week 13
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: What we're saying when we nominate no one else for the All-Star Game from the team perched atop these rankings for five straight Mondays is that, yes, LeBron has pretty much clinched our MVP vote already.

rankings.summaryHtml: Losing both regular-season games to Cleveland -- and getting pushed around in both -- was bad. Worse? How average the champs continue to look in road games: 10-8 compared to the Cavs' 17 road wins already.

rankings.summaryHtml: Melo's dinged up again, J.R. Smith is facing a possible one-game suspension for some questionable bench behavior ... and the Nuggets still hold the league's longest active win streak with six consecutive victories.

rankings.summaryHtml: The operative number for the Hawks: 20. As in: Jamal Crawford has a league-leading 18 games with at least 20 points off the bench. And: Atlanta just became the first team this season to record 20 double-digit wins.

rankings.summaryHtml: If anything sums up Orlando's disappointing first half, it's that not a single Magician besides Dwight Howard is generating any All-Star buzz. Let's see if an OT road win at scorching-hot Charlotte starts their turnaround.
